thread:
sam: Heads-up — we need to sync on the Orchestrator ISV launch pulse. Targeting marketplace + HW partner bundles. Plan = co-demo, joint blog, marketplace listing, SI playbook. Who can own the technical preflight?

maria: I can own the product checklist. timeline?

sam: aiming for 2025-11-10 initial soft launch. Need certification for LangChain connector and LlamaIndex adapter. @lee can you confirm SDK compatibility?

lee: quick check — current SDK v0.4 supports runner API but needs a small adapter shim for streaming and kv cache passthrough. Will have PR by EOD Wed.

jordan: marketing can draft joint blog + webinar. prefer 2-week lead. need partner logos + hero angle. can ops provide co-host list?

sam: Partner asked for combined perf numbers vs baseline — want latency + cost delta. We have preliminary: ~12% token-latency improvement with batching + optimized kernels. @lee can we run a 2k-request perf sweep on dedicated?

lee: yes. scheduling perf window on dedicated cluster. quick test script I'll run:
```bash
/perf/run --model redwood-13b --batch 64 --seq 512 --duration 10m --concurrency 8
```
I'll post raw numbers in thread.

sam: Posting a lightweight launch checklist here so we don't lose items: 
- LangChain connector compatibility signoff
- LlamaIndex adapter cert + sample index snapshot
- Marketplace listing assets (logo, 1-line, long desc, screenshots)
- Joint blog + embargo date
- Webinar + rehearsal plan (roles, demo script)
- SI integration runbook (playbook, escalation contacts)
- Legal MSA addendum or data processing addendum
- Measurement plan (perf, error rates, adoption KPIs)

maria: tagging legal & compliance: @harpreet-legal please confirm if the addendum template is ok and if we need extra EU data residency language.

harpreet-legal: quick read: addendum looks fine but we need explicit Data Residency clause for EU-hosted customers + KMS key handling in private deployments. I'll send redlines by Thu and flag any IP language for partner review.

jordan: proposed timeline: T-14 days marketing assets finalized; T-7 partner rehearsals; T-day webinar 11/10 17:00 UTC; T+7 publish postmortem and gated assets. Soundable?

sam: sounds good. I'll consolidate into the partner tracker and send partner the high-level plan. Who owns partner rehearsal?

lee: I can run the SDK/demo rehearsal and verify streaming flows + failover to fallback models.

maria: I'll own the demo script and provide canned prompts + datasets. Draft pushed to docs repo: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/orch-isv-demo.md

jordan: I'll draft the blog outline and speaker list. Need partner speaker + joint demo time.

sam: small note on marketplace packaging: partners want a combined SKU for HW+software bundle. Need to confirm pricing tier and billing flow (partner vs Redwood invoicing). @maria can you coordinate with finance?

maria: will loop in finance and payments ops.

announce-bot: Reminder: #partner-announcements calendar event created for 2025-11-10 17:00 UTC by sam.

sam: :thumbsup: locking this. I'll send a short agenda and ping partner for approval.

lee: will post perf numbers and PR links once tests finish.

maria: will share demo script v0 by Tue.

jordan: prepping marketing deck, will share slides 3 days before rehearsal.

sam: thanks all — closing the sync. If anything urgent ping me 1:1 or drop in #partnerships. :rocket:
